title: Testing the Café Menu  (تجربة قائمة المقهى)

segments.t: في وقت لاحق من مساء الأحد في ركن المقهى، تضع تيسا أطباق تذوّق صغيرة وشريحتين من التارت أمام كاليب وأوين. لنستمع إلى المشهد أولاً.
Every good neighborhood café needs one hot lunch bowl and one signature cake.
Did we just get promoted to official taste testers, Caleb?
Best job in the building! Which bowl do we try first, Tessa?
Left spoon: roasted tomato soup with fresh courtyard herbs.
Rich, warm, and great with crusty bread on a rainy afternoon!
Right spoon: golden lentil soup with lemon and olive oil, even better!
Now try the two lemon tart slices: thin pastry on the left, almond crust on the right.
Oh, the almond crust with Saturday market lemon is unbeatable!
Save one slice for Graham, Tessa, or he will lock us out of the kitchen!
So Wednesday's menu is set: golden lentil soup, warm bread, almond lemon tart, and tea!
Simple, honest, and easy to serve quickly from noon to evening.
Now let us hope for sunny skies tomorrow so our shutter paint dries!
